name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: A dropdown menu component built on Radix UI with items, groups, labels, sub-menus, error variants, and a composed shorthand. Uses namespace exports: Dropdown.Root, Dropdown.Trigger, Dropdown.Content, Dropdown.Item, Dropdown.Composed.

docs.lead: A dropdown menu component with items, groups, sub-menus, error variants, and a composed shorthand for common patterns.

examples.title: Default
examples.code:
<Dropdown.Root>
  <Dropdown.Trigger asChild>
    <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke">
      Open Dropdown
    </Button.Root>
  </Dropdown.Trigger>
  <Dropdown.Content align="start">
    <Dropdown.Group>
      <Dropdown.Item>
        <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiSettings2Line} />
        Settings
      </Dropdown.Item>
      <Dropdown.Item>
        <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiAddLine} />
        Add Item
      </Dropdown.Item>
      <Dropdown.Item>
        <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiLogoutBoxRLine} />
        Logout
      </Dropdown.Item>
    </Dropdown.Group>
  </Dropdown.Content>
</Dropdown.Root>

examples.title: With Groups

</Dropdown.Root>

examples.title: Sub Menu
examples.description: Dropdown with nested sub-menus for hierarchical navigation.
examples.code:
<Dropdown.Root>
  <Dropdown.Trigger asChild>
    <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke">Open</Button.Root>
  </Dropdown.Trigger>
  <Dropdown.Content align="start">
    <Dropdown.Group>
      <Dropdown.Item>
        <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiAddLine} />
        New post creation
      </Dropdown.Item>
      <Dropdown.MenuSub>
        <Dropdown.MenuSubTrigger>
          <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiFileList2Line} />
          Template Options
        </Dropdown.MenuSubTrigger>
        <Dropdown.MenuSubContent>
          <Dropdown.Item>
            <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiPencilLine} />
            Draft Post
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item>
            <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiRocketLine} />
            Publish Now
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item>
            <Dropdown.ItemIcon as={RiCalendar2Line} />
            Schedule Post
          </Dropdown.Item>
        </Dropdown.MenuSubContent>
      </Dropdown.MenuSub>
    </Dropdown.Group>
  </Dropdown.Content>
</Dropdown.Root>

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: The composed shorthand renders a full dropdown from a groups array. Separators are added between groups automatically.
examples.code:
<Dropdown.Composed
  groups={[
    {
      items: [
        { label: 'Activity', icon: RiPulseLine, onSelect: () => console.log('Activity') },
        { label: 'Integrations', icon: RiLayoutGridLine, onSelect: () => console.log('Integrations') },
        { label: 'Settings', icon: RiSettings2Line, onSelect: () => console.log('Settings') },
      ],
    },
    {
      items: [
        { label: 'Add Account', icon: RiAddLine },
        { label: 'Logout', icon: RiLogoutBoxRLine, variant: 'error' },
      ],
    },
  ]}
>
  <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke">
    Open Composed
  </Button.Root>
</Dropdown.Composed>

api.name: Dropdown.Root
api.description: The root dropdown container. Passes through Radix DropdownMenu.Root props.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes

api.name: Dropdown.Trigger
api.description: The element that opens the dropdown.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Dropdown.Content
api.description: The dropdown content panel with animations.

props.name: side
props.description: The preferred side to position the dropdown

props.name: align
props.description: The alignment relative to the trigger

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant. Error renders text and icon in red.

props.name: inset
props.description: Add left padding for alignment with icon items

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the item

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when the item is selected

api.name: Dropdown.ItemIcon
api.description: Polymorphic icon displayed inside a dropdown item. Inherits error color from variant.

props.name: as
props.description: The icon component to render

api.name: Dropdown.Label
api.description: An uppercase label for a group of dropdown items.

api.name: Dropdown.MenuSubTrigger
api.description: The item that opens a sub-menu. Shows a right arrow indicator.

props.name: inset
props.description: Add left padding for alignment

api.name: Dropdown.Composed
api.description: A composed shorthand that renders a full dropdown from a groups array. Handles trigger, content, items, separators, icons, and variants automatically.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element. Rendered via asChild.

props.name: groups
props.description: Array of menu groups. Each group has an optional label and an items array. Each item has label, optional icon, variant, disabled, onSelect, and href.

props.name: align
props.description: Content alignment relative to trigger

props.name: side
props.description: Content side relative to trigger

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Additional className for the content panel

props.name: header
props.description: Header content rendered above menu items

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content rendered below menu items

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes
